sample_unit: hemodynamic monitor screenshots (frames) from 5 liver transplant recipients, each rated by 5 anesthesiologists

links.outcome: Expert-rated content quality and catastrophic risk of ChatGPT interpretations of intraoperative hemodynamic screenshots
links.effect: Median domain scores 4.6 to 4.8; more than 90% of ratings satisfactory; 86% of catastrophic Risk ratings scored 0, with only three isolated high-risk assessments.
links.quote: ChatGPT demonstrated consistently high performance across all content-quality domains, with median scores ranging from 4.6 to 4.8 and more than 90% of all ratings classified as satisfactory.

unlisted_practices: Delphi-derived structured rating instrument (ARQuAT) to evaluate LLM clinical interpretations

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT's capability to interpret multimodal intraoperative hemodynamic monitoring screenshots in liver transplantation using expert clinician ratings via the ARQuAT tool, but does not test or compare a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
